answer: Each epoch hands every identity an unpredictable prompt seeded by the prior beacon and demands a fresh original text. Copying is brittle as quartz under a hammer: duplicate or templated answers shatter on a machine-checked uniqueness gate. An attacker running a saffron field of clones must have each one independently pick up the quill and author something genuinely new, so scaling fake agents means scaling real authored labor, not cloning one reply.
